blocks.heading: Mathematical modeling depth
paragraphs: Raytheon's missile guidance, radar signal processing, and electronic warfare programs require mathematical modeling at a depth that few commercial software environments approach. Engineers who have solved the coupled differential equations of guidance systems or the signal detection problems of radar return processing carry mathematical modeling skills that transfer powerfully to commercial ML.

blocks.heading: Systems integration experience
paragraphs: Raytheon's programs integrate thousands of hardware and software subsystems under requirements far more demanding than most commercial software programs. Engineers from this background are excellent at designing ML systems that integrate reliably with complex operational environments — a critical skill for production ML that academic ML programs don't develop.

blocks.heading: Quality and testing rigor
paragraphs: Defense manufacturing's zero-defect culture creates engineers with exceptional testing and quality discipline. Engineers who have worked under MIL-SPEC testing requirements or AS9100 quality systems bring testing rigor to commercial AI development that reduces the post-deployment surprises that less rigorous testing cultures produce.
